# National Parks Conservation Association

> > National Parks Conservation Association (NPCA) is America's leading independent advocacy organization dedicated to protecting and preserving the National Park System through policy advocacy, conservation campaigns, and public engagement.

NPCA works on critical issues including climate change, wildlife protection, the Endangered Species Act, air quality, and legislative advocacy. The organization monitors threats to national parks, provides testimony to Congress, and mobilizes supporters to defend America's natural and cultural heritage sites.

## Key Topics

- National Parks Conservation Association (NPCA)
- National Park Service
- Endangered Species Act (ESA)

## About NPCA

- [Our People](https://www.npca.org/people): Staff directory and leadership team bios for NPCA organization
- [Travel with NPCA](https://www.npca.org/trips): Educational travel program offering guided tours to national parks

## Policy Advocacy and Legislative Positions

- [Position on the Expanded Wildlife Extinction Package](https://www.npca.org/articles/1940-position-on-the-expanded-wildlife-extinction-package): NPCA testimony to House subcommittee opposing Endangered Species Act changes
- [Position on H.R. 845 & H.R. 1897](https://www.npca.org/articles/7637-position-on-h-r-845-h-r-1897): NPCA testimony opposing gray wolf delisting and ESA weakening legislation
- [5 Ways the New Congress Can Support National Parks](https://www.npca.org/articles/414-5-ways-the-new-congress-can-support-national-parks): Legislative priorities for 114th Congress to support national parks
- [Park group welcomes Interior report on oil and gas program](https://www.npca.org/articles/3045-park-group-welcomes-interior-report-on-oil-and-gas-program): NPCA response to Interior Department oil and gas leasing reform report
- [Court Defends Park Service's Authority to Manage Its Waterways](https://www.npca.org/articles/1651-court-defends-park-service-s-authority-to-manage-its-waterways): Ninth Circuit ruling affirms NPS authority over Yukon-Charley Rivers waters

## Climate Change and Environmental Policy

- [Trump Uses Executive Power to Shirk Responsibility on Climate Change](https://www.npca.org/articles/1507-trump-uses-executive-power-to-shirk-responsibility-on-climate-change): NPCA response to Trump executive order rolling back climate regulations
- [Trump Nominates Andrew Wheeler as EPA Administrator](https://www.npca.org/articles/2001-trump-nominates-andrew-wheeler-as-epa-administrator): NPCA statement on Andrew Wheeler EPA nomination and air quality concerns
- [Methane Rule Means Important Protections for National Parks](https://www.npca.org/articles/532-methane-rule-means-important-protections-for-national-parks): NPCA statement supporting EPA methane regulations for oil and gas emissions

## Wildlife and Habitat Conservation

- [The Grouse Effect](https://www.npca.org/articles/992-the-grouse-effect): Coalition efforts to protect endangered Gunnison sage-grouse habitat
- [Everglades Coalition Offers Plans to Restore Everglades and Protect Coastal Communities](https://www.npca.org/articles/740-everglades-coalition-offers-plans-to-restore-everglades-and-protect-coastal): Annual conference highlights Everglades restoration and coastal protection plans
- [The Real Housewives of Brooks River](https://www.npca.org/articles/4568-the-real-housewives-of-brooks-river): Kevin Grange book excerpt on Katmai grizzly bears and Fat Bear Week

## Historic Sites and Cultural Heritage

- [Stonewall Makes History Again: Becomes First National Park Site Dedicated to LGBT History](https://www.npca.org/articles/1266-stonewall-makes-history-again-becomes-first-national-park-site-dedicated-to): Obama designates Stonewall as first LGBT history national monument
- [Youth Push for Pullman on Capitol Hill](https://www.npca.org/articles/353-youth-push-for-pullman-on-capitol-hill): Youth advocates lobby for Chicago's Pullman Historic District national park
- [Heritage at the Heart of Rust Belt Reinvention](https://www.npca.org/articles/360-heritage-at-the-heart-of-rust-belt-reinvention): Visitor guide to Wheeling, West Virginia's industrial heritage sites

## Park Programs and Events

- [The Best of America, Free: It's National Park Week](https://www.npca.org/articles/215-the-best-of-america-free-it-s-national-park-week): National Park Week free admission announcement and visitor information
- [Building (on) Bridges](https://www.npca.org/articles/405-building-on-bridges): Anacostia Park improvements including Riverwalk Trail and Water Trail
- [Songs of the Wild](https://www.npca.org/articles/1309-songs-of-the-wild): Contemporary classical music performances in Shenandoah National Park
